- Must validate data isolation (audit logs + KMS) and on-prem routing options
- Integration owner will be engineering; security will need a short window for risk review

Proposed 60-min slots (all US Pacific):
- Tue, Nov 24 — 10:00 AM PT
- Wed, Nov 25 — 01:00 PM PT (preferred on our side)
- Thu, Nov 26 — 11:00 AM PT

Can you confirm which of these works and who from your team will join? Also confirm whether Zoom or Google Meet is preferred; if Zoom we’ll send a bridge and ICS.

Thanks,
